records.title: NumPert: Numerical Perturbations to Probe Language Models for Veracity Prediction
records.reason: NumPert probes language models for veracity prediction using numerical perturbations; it does not optimize inference cost or runtime.

records.title: Continual Learning Bench: Evaluating Frontier AI Systems in Real-World Stateful Environments
records.reason: Continual Learning Bench is an evaluation benchmark for stateful environments, not an inference-serving improvement.

records.title: What do Language Models Learn and When? The Implicit Curriculum Hypothesis
records.reason: The implicit-curriculum hypothesis studies what language models learn during training; it does not propose an inference-time efficiency improvement.

records.title: Learning from Trials and Errors: Reflective Test-Time Planning for Embodied LLMs
records.reason: Reflective test-time planning evaluates embodied-agent planning behavior; no concrete inference compute, memory, or serving improvement is presented.

records.title: MegaFlow: Large-Scale Distributed Orchestration System for the Agentic Era
records.reason: MegaFlow improves distributed agent-task orchestration/runtime, but the reported workload-level gains combine orchestration and external task execution rather than isolating LLM inference serving.
